description: This file defines an interface ILifecycleParticipant within the Orleans namespace, which provides a mechanism for objects to participate in a lifecycle observable pattern. It includes a method to add observers to the lifecycle.

classes.name: ILifecycleParticipant`1
classes.description: A generic interface allowing an object to act as a participant in a lifecycle, with a method to register observers.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Adds the provided lifecycle observer as a participant in the lifecycle.
